attributes.measurements: One concrete conversion was built and gated: InitEffects' FX_SUICIDEEXP zmod/alpha writes (`*(s32*)(ei+EFFECT_HEADER_OFFSET(FX_SUICIDEEXP,zmod))=-512; ...alpha))=0;`) rewritten as indexed access through the ALREADY-DECLARED, already-cached `u32* p960` pointer (`p960[1]=-512; p960[2]=0;` -- p960 already points at this exact EffectHeader row's `atree` field, so [1]/[2] land on zmod/alpha with zero new address materialization in principle). `defake_gate.py check --rebuild` reported REGRESSION InitEffects real 36 -> 150, with fndiff --ops confirming `opcode multiset: IDENTICAL (747/747) -- pure reorder, schedule-class residual` -- i.e. the SAME instructions, just reshuffled/rehomed by the register allocator, exactly the multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing mechanism. Reverted immediately (byte-identical to baseline confirmed by a second GATE OK run). The other ~11 EFFECT_HEADER_OFFSET-kind blocks in InitEffects (GENFX1/2/3, ALTHIT, ALTDIE, ENEATK1/2, ENEDEATH1/2, DEATH_HEALTH, DEATH_EXP) were NOT individually tried after this single representative failure, per the project's 'two identical A/B kill an axis' guidance -- all 12 blocks share byte-identical C shape (same macro, same pNNN-pointer precedent, same 2-field write pattern), so one clean negative result is treated as governing the whole homogeneous set rather than re-spending 11 more build+gate cycles to confirm the same mechanism 11 more times. Two debt-census entries were confirmed FALSE POSITIVES, not real fakematch sites: ProcessSkinFX:317 is `fx->rate * (f32)(gFrameTicks >> 1)` -- a harmless integer-to-float scalar cast with no pointer/struct reinterpretation, matched by the census regex's generic `(TYPE)(...)` pattern; and the file-scope line 212 hit is the `FX_POOL_F32` macro's OWN definition text (`#define FX_POOL_F32(i,off) (*(f32*)...)`), not a call site. ProcessEffects:3492 (`*(u32*)(lbl_8023CB28+68)`) was screened and left raw on purpose: `lbl_8023CB28` has no verified owning struct in this TU (no GC-verified header covers it), so per the 'never invent names, leave raw or introduce a verified file-local view' rule there is nothing safe to convert it to. StartEnemyDeathFX (~6 sites, lines ~1536-1543 in this session's numbering) was read but NOT attempted: the function carries `#pragma opt_propagation off` (a codegen-sensitive pragma per prior campaign notes) plus a walked pointer (`fxp += 2996`, `fxp += off`, lwzu-idiom-adjacent per claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention) and an index-computed base (`base + idx*240`) touching 2+ nearby Effect fields -- the same risk signature that just regressed in InitEffects, on a function with zero prior probing history and low site-count payoff; deferred rather than spent on a predicted-negative trial given session time budget.
